title: Lattice vertex algebras of type ADE over fields of prime characteristic and their representations
summary: We study lattice vertex algebras of type ADE over an algebraically closed field $\mathbb{F}$ of prime characteristic $p>2$ and their representations. Let $L$ be a root lattice of type ADE, and $G_{L}$ the Gram matrix of $L$. When $\det G_{L}\not \equiv 0\pmod{p}$, we establish an isomorphism between the lattice vertex algebra $V_{L,\mathbb{F}}$ and the level-one simple affine vertex algebra of the same type.
